Night Cream Under 1000: How to Choose by Price per Gram

By Mohammed Nihal, founderPublished 20 October 2026Updated 16 October 20265 min read
Quick answer

Under ₹1,000 you can get a full-size night cream with a moisturising base and one or two actives. Compare price per gram and texture: the 30 g Avocado Night Cream (₹649) suits dry skin, the 25 g Korean night cream suits most skin, and the 15 g Avocado Glow Cream suits oily or sensitive skin.

  • Avocado Night Cream 30 g is about ₹22 per gram
  • Day & Night Combo (₹849) is about ₹21 per gram
  • A 30 g jar lasts about 6–8 weeks nightly
  • Use sunscreen every morning with kojic acid creams

A night cream under 1000 rupees can give you a full-size jar with a moisturising base and one or two well-known actives, which is all most skin needs at night. The useful way to choose is not the jar price but price per gram, texture for your skin type, and whether you want actives such as kojic acid or a plain moisturiser.

Below are the five options in our range under ₹1,000, a price-per-gram table, how to pick by skin type, and when it is genuinely worth spending more.

What changes between ₹500 and ₹1,000

  • Full sizes. Under ₹500 you mostly get small jars or very simple creams. Between ₹500 and ₹1,000, 25–50 g jars with a few useful ingredients become common.
  • Lower cost per month. A bigger jar used nightly usually works out cheaper than repeatedly buying small ones.
  • Room for a day and night pair. Some combos fit under ₹1,000.

What does not change: no cream at this price, or any price, should promise to change your natural skin colour. For the cheaper end, see our guide to night cream under 500.

The Avocado Night Cream is our lowest price per gram among single jars, and the combo is slightly lower again because you buy two jars at once. Every cream except the 15 g Avocado Glow Cream contains kojic acid, so use sunscreen every morning with those.

How to choose by skin type

Dry skin, winter or AC rooms

Pick the 30 g Avocado Night Cream. It is the richer of our two avocado night creams and a good fit when skin feels tight after washing, which is common with hard water. See avocado cream for dry skin.

Oily skin or humid cities

Use the 15 g Avocado Glow Cream, or a thin layer of either night cream. In Mumbai, Chennai or Kochi humidity, less cream is usually more comfortable. Read night cream for oily skin.

Combination or normal skin

The 25 g Avocado Korean Night Cream suits most skin types. Use a little more on dry cheeks and less on the T-zone.

Sensitive skin

Start with the 15 g Avocado Glow Cream, which has no kojic acid. Move to an active cream later, after a patch test, if you want one.

Dull or uneven-looking skin

Either 25 g or 30 g cream, used nightly with sunscreen every morning. Expect 8–12 weeks for a more even look, not days.

Still unsure? The skin quiz takes a minute, and our comparison of Avocado Night Cream vs Avocado Korean Night Cream covers the two ₹649 jars in detail.

Single jar or the ₹849 combo?

The Day & Night Combo pairs the 10 g Avocado Glow Nourishing Skin Cream for mornings with the 30 g Avocado Night Cream for nights. It makes sense if you want two creams with the same ingredients for a simple routine, or as a gift. If you already have a day moisturiser and sunscreen you like, a single ₹649 jar is enough.

One thing to know: the 10 g day cream in the combo contains kojic acid, so always put sunscreen on top in the morning.

When it is worth paying more

Spending above ₹1,000 makes sense when you want specific ingredients these creams do not have:

  • Glutathione and vitamin C: our Glutathione Cream (30 g, ₹1,499) adds both, alongside kojic acid, aloe vera and vitamin B3, for dull or uneven-looking skin.
  • Hyaluronic acid, centella and alpha arbutin: our Glass Glow Cream (30 g, ₹2,499) has glutathione, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, centella asiatica and alpha arbutin, and no kojic acid.

If your main need is comfort and moisture, the extra spend does little. Our guide on affordable vs premium night cream walks through the trade-off.

Before you buy online

  • Buy from the brand's own site or a trusted seller, and check the seal on arrival.
  • Look for the use-before date and batch number on the pack.
  • Patch test for 24–48 hours on the jawline before full use.
  • We ship free across India, usually in 3–7 days, with Cash on Delivery, and accept returns on sealed jars within 7 days. See our shipping policy.

You can compare every jar on our night creams page.

Short answers

What is a good night cream under 1000 for dry skin? A full-size, richer cream with a moisturising base. In our range, that is the Avocado Night Cream, 30 g for ₹649.

Which Mirc Glow cream has the lowest price per gram? The Day & Night Combo at about ₹21 per gram, then the Avocado Night Cream at about ₹22.

Is there a night cream under 1000 without kojic acid? Yes, the Avocado Glow Cream 15 g at ₹399, with avocado and aloe vera only.

What is the difference between the two ₹649 creams? They share key ingredients; the 30 g Avocado Night Cream is richer and larger, while the 25 g Korean night cream suits most skin types.

Do I need sunscreen with these creams? Yes, every morning with any cream containing kojic acid, and ideally every day anyway.

This is general skincare information, not medical advice. Patch test any new product, and see a dermatologist if you have a skin condition.
